test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT associated with Brahmo Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmaram Panduranga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atmaram Panduranga** was **not associated** with **Brahmo Samaj**.
 
• He was **associated **with the **Prarthana Samaj**, which was a **reformist Hindu movement** primarily centred in **Maharashtra, India**. 
 
• Played a crucial role in **establishing and growing the Prarthana Samaj**.
 
• **Atmaram Pandurang** was a prominent figure in the **19th-century Indian reform movements**.
 
• Left a lasting impact on **Indian society, particularly in Maharashtra.**
 
• **Advocated against social evils** such as **caste discrimination and untouchability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keshab Chandra Sen**

 
 
• Prominent leader of the **Brahmo Samaj**.
 
• Advocated for **social reforms** within the **Brahmo Samaj.**
 
• Spread the ideals of the **Brahmo Samaj**.
 
 
 
• **Debendranath Tagore**
 
 
• One of the **founders of the Brahmo Samaj**.
 
• **Shaped** the early **ideology and principles** of the **Brahmo Samaj**.
 
• Promoted **monotheism**, **rationality**, and **social equality**.
 
 
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**
 
 
• Not directly associated with the **Brahmo Samaj **but **laid the groundwork for its emergence**.
 
• Pioneering figure in **Indian socio-religious reform movements**.
 
• Campaigned against practices like **Sati and advocated for social reforms**.
 
• **Founded** the **Brahmo Sabha**, which **evolved** into the **Brahmo Samaj**.
